_layout_comment: Equal spacing: exactly 20 px between every pair of neighbouring photos. Portrait photos go in rows (2 side by side, filling left to right or right to left); the wide photos go in a column (top to bottom). Every photo in a row shares a height, so the gaps stay even; gallery.py picks the row split that makes the photos biggest. Groups with a 'tree' use a nested arrangement instead (h = side by side, v = stacked), still exactly 20 px between neighbours.
